Fix: hoist `base = os.path.join(S.SKILL, 'work', src['id'])` above the loop; add a test_figures.py case 'empty segment indexes to zero figures and writes an empty figure_index.json without crashing'.

new_hazards_found.summary: lexicon.py --find anchor QUALITY (second night in a row): the Tier-2 'TERM is …' frame accepted a USAGE sentence 82 pages away ('vowel quality is the easiest way to distinguish between س and ص', p122) while the book's real definition sits on the marked page in a reverse naming frame the finder has no pattern for ('we refer to these differences in pronunciation as vowel quality'). The drafter-side guard held (anchor kept external + flagged), but the gate's 'an in-source definition EXISTS — anchor to it' warning pushes the wrong way and has no structured place to record the clearance, so it recurs on every re-run. Also noted by the judge: an external-anchored card that WAS checked against the page cannot record that in verified_against without flipping the derived flag and tripping R35 — the null is forced by the machinery.
new_hazards_found.deferred: daytime: add reverse naming frames ('we refer to … as TERM', 'is called TERM', 'known as TERM') to _def_patterns; exclude predicate-of-usage verbs ('is the easiest/best way to …'); add lexicon.py --self-test cases; consider a `cleared_warnings` card field the gate honours.
